newsitem.title: USA: Illinois Superconductor gets new customer.
newsitem.headline: Illinois Superconductor gets new customer.

text.p: Illinois Superconductor Corp said Friday it entered into a letter of intent with a fourth major U.S. cellular operator to purchase its RangeMaster cellular base station filter products.
Neither the name of the customer nor the terms of the transaction were disclosed.
The new customer serves nearly four million cellular subscribers in over 100 markets across the United States.
The RangeMaster units will be installed in one of the customer's primary markets located in the Midwest, Illinois Superconductor sid.

"ISCO's filter products are currently installed and operating in multiple cell sites of three of the nine largest cellular operators in the U.S., and we are happy to add a fourth major customer to our rapidly growing list of large accounts," Bob Riccitelli, vice president of sales and marketing, said in a statement.
Illinois Superconductor provides high temperature superconducting technology for the wireless telecommunications industry.
